What the released interface consumes: A 0/1 indicator over the measured gene panel, embedded with Gene2Vec and spread by attention over a gene-similarity graph.

A cell decomposed into a residual state and declared attributes; a perturbation is either a categorical attribute (seen labels only) or an ordered attribute (RDKit chemistry for compounds, GO-neighbour vectors for genes), in which an unseen perturbation is an unseen value rather than a missing category.

A conditional flow from the control cell distribution to the perturbed one, with the perturbation entering as a learned embedding of any numeric representation supplied for it through perturbation_covariate_reps.
The control and the observed perturbed cell populations of one perturbation, from which one transport map is fitted; the holdout is the population the map is applied to.
Control and treated populations of observed cells; the released call returns a confounder-adjusted single-cell treatment effect and accepts no held-out group or unobserved label.
One learned embedding per perturbation label seen in training, composed with covariate embeddings; the released chemistry configuration replaces that lookup with an RDKit/Morgan molecular encoder.
Morgan fingerprints of the training compounds and their control-to-treated shifts; written for this benchmark, not a published method.
A gene symbol carrying a node in the method's Gene Ontology graph, plus the training expression object the released predict call reads its control cells from.
The control-only PCA loading of the perturbed gene and the training knockouts' shifts; written for this benchmark, not a published method.
A perturbation embedding from the GEARS graph encoder over the GO vocabulary, fed to a GO-masked adaptation head on a frozen foundation encoder.

A perturbation's structure read by a pretrained encoder (ChemicalVAE on SMILES, GenotypeVAE on GO annotation), mapped to a cell-state distribution by a conditional invertible flow; the flow is conditioned on the perturbation alone.
An unperturbed cell paired with an FCFP4 fingerprint of the compound's SMILES scaled by log10(dose + 1); it carries no cell-line or donor covariate.
A cell's counts on a fixed 19,264-gene panel; the released model returns an embedding and publishes no perturbation-conditioning input at all.
Perturbation-labelled cells and a condition key that must already be present in training; the prediction is a latent shift decoded on the held group's own control cells.
A perturbation flag added to the token embedding of the perturbed gene, so the perturbation must be a gene in the model's vocabulary.
One control key and one stimulation key; the perturbation itself is never an argument, so the condition must be present in training as a perturbed population.
A set of the target population's own control cells plus a perturbation embedding, which the released perturbation-feature file may supply as any continuous vector.
